standard-dialogue.npc: Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!

standard-dialogue.player: Does it happen to be... Ali?

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!

standard-dialogue.player: So can I call you Al?

standard-dialogue.npc: Only if I can call you Betty!
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.

standard-dialogue.player: Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.

standard-dialogue.npc: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!

standard-dialogue.player: Sorry! I won't let it happen again.

standard-dialogue-after-the-feud.npc: Good day to you too, Blockhead.
Have you good reason to disturb me again?
I warned you about needlessly bothering me. That's it! I'm turning you into a frog!
Don't taunt me, fool! Once I find a spare minute you'll be ribbiting on the other side of your face, you mark my words!
